title: Databricks Just Ditched Claude for a Chinese AI Model
description:
China is quietly winning the AI coding war and nobody's really talking about it 🔥

Databricks just dropped Claude for a chinese model called GLM 5.2 (from Zhipu AI) to cut costs. They tested it across millions of lines of code, and the quality came out basicaly on par with Claude Opus 4.8, but a task runs $1.30 instead of $1.90. It quietly became their go-to coding tool.

And it's not just them. Coinbase cut their AI spend in half using the same models, their share on OpenRouter jumped from 11 to 30 percent since february 😅 The price gap got so wide that giants are literaly ripping out infrastructure, even when the quality isnt that far behind ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
